meta.name: cull-release-recover
meta.description: Use when a Cull release is stuck, inconsistent, failed in a workflow or artifact gate, missing Homebrew promotion, failed after publication, or needs a safe recovery or patch plan.

copy.tagline: 排查并修复Cull版本发布卡滞与失败
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责Cull版本发布管理且常遇到流程卡顿或失败
copy.tagline_en: Debug and fix stuck or failed Cull releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Cull releases and often face stuck or failed states

howto.what: Claude 会检查 Cull 发布状态，通过外部证据诊断问题，然后安全地恢复卡住或失败的发布流程，不会破坏已有发布记录。
howto.when: 当 Cull 发布卡住、状态不一致、工作流失败、缺少 Homebrew 推广或发布后失败时触发。

say.text: 我的 Cull 版本发布卡住了，帮我诊断并恢复。
say.note: Claude 会检查并尝试恢复发布。

say.text: 发布后验证失败，帮我准备补丁计划。
say.note: Claude 会制定补丁计划但不会自动发布。

say.text: 检查 Homebrew 推广是否已完成。
say.note: Claude 会验证 Homebrew 状态。

howto.what_en: Claude will diagnose a Cull release by checking external evidence, then safely resume stuck or failed releases without altering immutable history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a Cull release is stuck, inconsistent, workflow or artifact gate failed, missing Homebrew promotion, or failed post-publication, or needs a safe recovery or patch plan.

say_en.text: My Cull release is stuck; help diagnose and resume it.
say_en.note: Claude will check and attempt to resume.

say_en.text: Post-publish verification failed; prepare a patch plan.
say_en.note: Claude will draft a plan but not publish.

say_en.text: Check if Homebrew promotion is done.
